fields.Name: T079 - Configure View Column Format Editor
fields.Description: Per-column formatting (type/decimals/currency/date-format/alignment/colors + live preview) is a distinct rich sub-feature; existing column-management coverage only exercises show/hide/reorder.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Products', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Open Configure View (sliders icon in the view toolbar) and stay on the 'Columns' tab. Each visible column row has a paintbrush 'Format column' button — click it for any column. Success is the column format-editor sub-panel opening with a 'Format Type' dropdown (Text / Number / Currency / Date / Boolean / etc.), an alignment toggle, header/cell style buttons, and a live Preview. Seeing the format editor render is success — you do NOT need to save formatting.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a column's paintbrush button opens the format-editor sub-panel
The editor shows a Format Type selector plus alignment/style controls and a Preview section
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
